description: Defines the StatsRoute class which builds HTTP routes for statistics endpoints in an Akka HTTP server, including handling requests for statistics data, details, and counts, with DevOps authentication and configuration.

classes.name: StatsRoute
classes.description: Builds HTTP routes for statistics endpoints, handling requests for statistics data, details, and counts with DevOps authentication.

methods.name: buildStatsRoute
methods.description: Creates the main /stats route with subroutes for /things and /search.

methods.name: buildSubRoutes
methods.description: Builds subroutes under /stats for /things and /search endpoints.

methods.name: buildDetailsRoute
methods.description: Builds the /stats/things/details route with DevOps basic authentication.

methods.name: handleDevOpsPerRequest
methods.description: Handles requests by executing DevOps commands and returning HTTP responses.

methods.name: handleSudoCountThingsPerRequest
methods.description: Handles /stats/search requests to count things and return JSON response.

methods.name: buildDevOpsDittoHeaders
methods.description: Constructs DittoHeaders with correlation ID for DevOps requests.
